newsitem.title: USA: Rubin - rates likely to vary in line with growth.
newsitem.headline: Rubin - rates likely to vary in line with growth.

text.p: Market interest rates are likely to remain consistent with the maintenance of solid economic growth so long as the United States keeps its budget under control, Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Tuesday.
"Today interest rates fluctuate as they should with the strength and weakness of the economy," he told businessmen at a meeting sponsored by the White House.
"Market interest rates are likely to remain consistent wiht solid growth over the long term as long as we don't go back on a path of fiscal irresponsibility," he added.
